name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: Users aim to quickly find recycling centers by zip code and view their operational details and locations on a map.
Users want to be informed about new recycling events and updates relevant to their interests.
Users desire the ability to save preferred facilities and customize their experience within the application.
Administrators need to maintain up-to-date and correct information about all recycling facilities listed in the application.
Administrators aim to process and respond to user feedback and complaints to improve the service.
Administrators are responsible for safeguarding user information and ensuring compliance with data security standards.
Facility Representatives seek the ability to directly modify their facility's details, such as operational hours and accepted materials.
Facility Representatives need a channel to convey issues, concerns, or updates directly to the site administrators.
lowLevelGoals: Users can enter their zip code into a search field to initiate a search for recycling facilities in that area.
After entering a zip code, the system displays a list of recycling facilities found within that geographical area.
Users can click on a facility from the search results to access a detailed view of its information.
The system displays the opening and closing times for the chosen recycling facility.
The system lists the types of materials (e.g., plastic, paper, glass) that the chosen facility accepts for recycling.
The application displays the geographical location of the chosen facility on a map interface, allowing for navigation.
Users can opt-in to receive alerts when new recycling events are announced.
The system sends alerts to users when details of events they are interested in are modified.
Users can specify which types of recyclable materials they want to receive event notifications for.
Users can set preferences to receive event notifications only for specific zip codes or regions.
Users can mark specific recycling facilities as favorites for quick access later.
The application displays a dedicated section where users can see all the facilities they have marked as favorites.
Users can deselect a facility from their favorites list, removing it from that personalized collection.
Users can configure a default zip code so that searches automatically start from that location.
Users can modify their account details, such as contact information or login credentials.
Administrators can input all necessary information to register a new recycling facility within the system.
Administrators can modify any aspect of a facility's information, such as address, hours, or accepted materials.
Administrators can delete facility entries from the database that are no longer relevant or accurate.
Administrators can examine proposed updates from facility representatives and decide whether to publish them.
Administrators can access a comprehensive list of all feedback, suggestions, or complaints submitted by users.
Administrators can sort feedback entries to focus on specific categories of user input.
Administrators can update the status of feedback items to track their progress and resolution.
Administrators can compose and send messages directly to users who have submitted feedback.
Administrators can review a record of who accessed or changed user information and when.
Administrators can define and assign different access levels and capabilities to various user types.
Administrators can configure the system to encrypt personal user data to protect it from unauthorized access.
Administrators can perform periodic checks to ensure the integrity and security of stored user information.
Facility representatives can access a secure section of the application designed for managing their facility's information.
Facility representatives can see all the information currently listed for their specific recycling facility.
Facility representatives can modify the opening and closing times displayed for their facility.
Facility representatives can add or remove types of materials that their facility accepts for recycling.
After making modifications, facility representatives can submit their updates to administrators for approval before they go live.
Facility representatives can use an in-app messaging system to communicate with administrators.
Facility representatives can see replies and updates from administrators within the messaging system.
Facility representatives can upload supporting files (e.g., photos, PDFs) when sending messages to administrators.
